n01.roman: GTA 5 ke GTA Online mein asli paise se game ka paisa khareeda jaata hai: Shark Card.

n02.roman: Sabse bada, Megalodon Shark Card: 1 crore GTA dollar. PlayStation Store India par poori keemat: ₹5,799.

n03.roman: Yaani 1 rupaye mein kareeb 1,700 GTA dollar!

n04.roman: Twist: ye card lagbhag GTA 6 jitna mehnga hai! GTA 6 ka Standard Edition: ₹5,999. Farq sirf ₹200!

n05.roman: Aur GTA Online ki sabse mehngi sawaari, Luxor Deluxe jet: poore 1 crore GTA dollar! Yaani poora card, ek hi jet mein khatam.

n06.roman: Toh game mein crorepati banna aasaan hai... bas asli jeb dheeli karni padti hai!
